item.desc: It sleeps in skulls and wakes up hungry.
Its glowing abdomen lights up the hive at night.
Its shell glows red hot whenever it gets angry, which is often.
A coconut that trained in the art of stealth. Mostly it just falls on people.
A spark of sunlight that learned how to giggle.
Nobody knows which kingdom it rules, including the frog itself.
Gumley is composed of intelligent polysaccharides that fused together to create a unified consciousness.
A mischievous little flame that loves to play tricks.
Under that coy smile lies an insidious curio with clandestine intent.
A giant microbe that feeds on stray static charge.
Half mantis, half artillery, all business.
Pulled from the ground at midnight, it has been cranky ever since.
It carries messages, snacks and the occasional lost curio in its beak.
Always dressed for the occasion, even underwater.
Its fluffy wool traps gusts of wind that it lets loose in a single burst.
It splits sunlight into rainbows, and enemies into pieces.
A forgotten doll stitched together with a stubborn will.
Beautiful to look at, painful to pick.
It is always right behind you.
A tiny ant that burns hot enough to melt sand into glass.
Moss grows on its back because it rarely moves.
It circles over frozen peaks waiting for the wind to change.
Don't take a bite. It bites back.
Sworn to protect its friends, it never takes off its armor.
It sings during thunderstorms, and the storms sing back.
Handle with care. Claymore has a very short fuse.
The light on its lure is the last thing its prey ever sees.
The Hydragon's heads can't seem to cooperate with one another unless they're in combat.
Its grin burns brighter every night of the harvest.
Its shell is harder than the rocks it sleeps under.
It hides inside its pot and peeks out only to fight.
An ancient mask that dances around the island bonfires.
Tropigust rides warm island breezes and never lands for long.
A toxic hound whose drool eats through steel.
The captain went down with the ship, and came back up again.
Slow, patient and absolutely impossible to move.
Playful as a kitten, fierce as a dragon.
A noble sky hunter that answers only to the brave.
Carved from driftwood by the tide, it roams the shore at dawn.
The terror of the seven seas, and of the local fish market.
A walking furnace built around a molten heart.
It sheds its skin in a puff of smoke.
Its mane crackles with lightning before every pounce.
A young yeti whose fur reflects the glow of the northern lights.
An ancient stone guardian that has grown a garden on its back.
